examples.description: Remove the name from version 12 of one studio project

description: Remove the name from a studio project's named version, freeing one of its 20 names. The version stays stored; from the next save it follows the normal retention and may be deleted. A version without a name answers removed: false. Refuses: a project_id outside your scope (NOT_FOUND): studio_project_list lists your projects; pass one of their ids; a version the project no longer stores (SIMPLER_STUDIO_VERSION_NOT_STORED): call studio.list_versions and pick a listed one; an environment where names are not switched on yet (SIMPLER_STUDIO_SNAPSHOTS_UNAVAILABLE): saving and restoring still work; ask the owner to apply DB_MEDIA migration 0005. Free.
